summary: Audit SurgeIndex repository end-to-end for launch readiness: map structure, evaluate subsystem evidence (migrations, auth, tracker, GA4, Stripe, backups, VPS), classify blockers, and produce a report with concrete evidence — without performing any production deploy or unapproved writes.

tasks.objective: Produce a structural map of the SurgeIndex repository: top-level layout, monorepo vs split, languages/frameworks (frontend, backend, worker/collector), config files, CI configs, Docker/Compose manifests, env example files, and an inventory of the documented launch-checklist items if any README/LAUNCH/DEPLOY docs exist.
acceptance: File tree summary with key paths (frontend, backend, migrations, tracker/collector, scoring, payments, deploy, docs)
List of detected frameworks (e.g., Next.js/React, Node/Express/Fastify/Nest, Python, etc.) with evidence file paths
Identification of env example files and required env vars (without printing secrets)

tasks.objective: Audit the PostgreSQL schema and migration setup: locate migration tool (Prisma/Knex/sequelize/SQL files/Drizzle), list all migration filenames in order, verify checksum/integrity if a manifest exists, and assess upgrade path (e.g., dev DB up to head, down/reset support). Where the environment allows, run migration status (e.g., `prisma migrate status`, `knex migrate:status`) in dry/read-only mode and capture output.
acceptance: Ordered list of migrations with filenames and brief purpose inferred from code
Evidence of migration tool detected and any status command output captured
Classification: migration system healthy vs. blockers (e.g., missing baseline, unapplied migrations, no idempotent reset path)

tasks.objective: Audit authentication and related anti-abuse / messaging flows: sign-up, login, password reset, session/JWT handling, Cloudflare Turnstile integration, transactional email (verification, password reset) provider wiring. Inspect route handlers, middleware, env var usage, and any tests covering these paths. Do not call external services; treat secrets as absent.
acceptance: Map of auth routes/middlewares and where Turnstile verification occurs (server-side vs client-only) with file references
Email provider config locations and required env vars (names only)
List of existing auth-related tests and which flows are covered vs missing
Classification of code-fixable auth gaps vs external credential gaps (Turnstile keys, SMTP)

tasks.objective: Audit the data pipeline: site submission/ingest, tracker/collector (bot detection, fingerprinting, rate limiting), aggregation jobs, scoring engine, ranking output, and 'breakout' freshness signals. Identify scheduling mechanism (cron, queue, worker), idempotency, retry behavior, and any data-quality checks.
acceptance: Pipeline diagram in text form (ingest -> collect -> aggregate -> score -> rank) with entry-point file paths
Identification of scheduler/queue tech and how jobs are triggered
Notes on idempotency/dedup and freshness/SLA for 'breakout' detection with code references
Classification of pipeline gaps as code-fixable vs requiring infra/credentials

tasks.objective: Audit GA4 analytics integration and Stripe test-mode integration (note: write operators disabled, so this is read-only config/code review only). For GA4: confirm measurement ID env, where gtag/GA4 events are emitted, and which key user events are tracked. For Stripe: confirm test keys via env, checkout/portal webhook routes, webhook signature verification, and subscription/plan mapping.
acceptance: GA4: env var names, init location, list of emitted events with file references
Stripe: env var names (publishable/secret/webhook secret), routes for checkout/portal/webhook, evidence of signature verification, plan/price mapping locations
Classification: code gaps vs missing test-mode credentials; no live network calls performed

tasks.objective: Audit operational readiness outside application code: backup/restore tooling (pg_dump scripts, cron entries, offsite target), monitoring/health endpoints, logging, and VPS/deploy artifacts (Dockerfile, compose, systemd unit, reverse proxy config, TLS). Read-only inspection; do not execute remote commands.
acceptance: Inventory of backup scripts/configs with retention approach and restore test evidence (or note if untested)
List of health/readiness endpoints and logging libraries used
Deploy artifacts summary: containerization, process manager, reverse proxy, TLS handling with file references
Classification: code-fixable ops gaps vs infrastructure/credential gaps

tasks.objective: Run the project's available non-destructive checks to gather evidence: dependency install (if lockfile present and permitted), lint, typecheck, unit tests, and a read-only migration status check. Do not run anything that requires network writes or production credentials. Capture command output snippets.
acceptance: Recorded exit codes and short output excerpts for each attempted check (install, lint, typecheck, test, migration status)
List of checks skipped and reason (e.g., missing tool, network restriction, secrets unavailable)
No writes performed against external systems

tasks.objective: Synthesize all prior task findings into a single launch-readiness report for the user. For each critical subsystem, attach concrete evidence (file paths, command outputs) and classify blockers as code-fixable vs external (credentials/infra/VPS). Explicitly call out that production deploy/push remains approval-gated. Do not propose or perform any deploy.
acceptance: Per-subsystem sections (migrations, auth/Turnstile/email, tracker/scoring/rank/breakout, GA4, Stripe, backups, VPS/deploy, SEO/docs) each with evidence pointers and blocker classification
Top-level 'Can we launch?' verdict with required preconditions and a short next-step list
Explicit note that production deploy/push is approval-gated and was not performed
